description.value: Anar Persian Cuisine is a family-oriented restaurant specializing in Persian kebabs and stews, recently merged with Lavash Seaside Grill and relocated to a waterfront spot on Bayview Street in Richmond. The new location offers ocean views and live music on Thursdays and Saturdays, making it a distinctive dining destination. The menu features a broad range of Persian dishes including multiple vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options.
